requirements.contract: Typing, controls, Unicode and paste leave remote history and arrive unchanged
Mouse gestures only select; explicit Ctrl+C copies without clearing selection or moving the viewport; OSC 52 survives redraw
Mouse-aware applications get ordinary unshifted header clicks and wheel input
Wheel down exits at the bottom, while focus changes do not
Shift+Page keys browse but ordinary arrows go to the application
Read-only viewer input cannot exit history or reach the pane
Stock Mosh can browse old history, copy, type, resize, survive simulated loss and reconnect while desktop stays attached
tmux is the patched native binary, not a Python launcher; native session/client/window commands, aliases, version and argument semantics work directly
Installers refuse foreign paths before changing links; Mosh helper refuses unmarked or unsafe servers; native tmux retains its standard server-selection semantics
Desktop helper only uses an explicitly available display
Independent terminal oracles observe the actual alternate-screen viewport
Config advertises hyperlink support; OSC 8 file targets survive drawing, retained history and native reattachment
Real XFCE widget Ctrl-click opens explicit and detected file paths; Ctrl-Shift-click requests parent directory selection using the pane CWD
Pane metadata lookup preserves the app allowlist and bounds unresponsive-server queries without killing the original client or server
Native tmux loads the canonical config through ~/.tmux.conf; -f retains native configuration selection; no launcher-specific config lookup
Existing servers neither reload nor require the config when adding or reattaching sessions
Bootstrap installs canonical native config and Fish symlinks idempotently, preserves archives and refuses foreign files before changes
new-session/new [-A] -s NAME supports native create-or-attach syntax, preserves existing programs and viewers, rejects duplicate names without -A, and preserves native program argument semantics
tmux-mosh clients [--json] lists session, transport, reachability, peer, geometry and sizing read-only; it creates neither a server nor a monitor

Timestamped read-only inventory includes detached sessions and control clients, separates process attachment from Mosh reachability, reports existing tmux activity timestamps without claiming network contact, and distinguishes SSH/local/unknown ancestry; closing a real private XFCE window removes the client without stopping its session or program

Read-only inventory includes this user's direct-app Mosh sessions even without a selected tmux server, uses foreground process groups instead of background jobs, deduplicates represented Mosh clients, labels other-tmux connections, and does not invent reachability or activity from stale login records

One shared table and additive JSON entries array covers local/SSH/Mosh tmux clients, detached sessions and direct/other-tmux Mosh; active-pane foreground app PIDs remain distinct from Mosh server PIDs, unavailable fields stay unknown, and one process snapshot supplies all app discovery

SIZING identifies the actual native latest-policy controller per current window as active, distinguishes eligible standby and ignored viewers, transfers on input even for equal-sized viewers, preserves native policy/fallback behavior, and reports unknown on old servers without changing live sizing or restarting sessions
Explicitly unreachable Mosh clients release their size constraint; reconnect restores it without ending either viewer or the application or replacing the configured latest/smallest policy
Unknown or ambiguous login state never creates an exclusion; manual flags survive and only recorded automatic flags are restored, including after crashes

Native attachment hooks or explicit tmux-mosh ensure/start launch one bounded-polling helper; unchanged polls do not redraw, and server replacement, unsafe lock paths and PID reuse cannot redirect updates
client-attached and after-new-session automatically ensure Mosh sizing without a command launcher; repeated calls reuse one monitor and status remains independently usable on startup failure

A portrait phone taller than the desktop uses its own full height when active; keyboard close and history browsing restore full height; desktop/phone input switches the shared size without restarting programs, directly and over stock Mosh

Owned client display environment updates only its current session; phone or empty display values do not erase desktop clipboard access, other tmux environment updates remain active, and quoted values cannot inject commands
Fish adds only the existing private socket default, creates an owned mode-0700 directory if absent, refuses unsafe paths, and preserves all arguments and explicit/inherited server selection
Reloading only the integration fragment preserves unrelated bindings, options, server/pane identities and running program input

Application-owned OSC 52 selections reach the configured desktop helper using refreshed session display variables and only the interacting viewer; bare Pi and write-only wrapped Codex requests respect set-clipboard policy without enabling general passthrough or wrapped reads

Actual XFCE Ctrl+C events with menus shown or hidden deliver application-owned clipboard fixtures through a fresh patched server to a private X11 clipboard, even when the application started without a desktop display

Terminal and stock-Mosh loopback harnesses resolve inside tmux-simple; Termux classes are built locally rather than linked to a sibling project; each emulator renders a synthetic fixture without needing retired projects
Real Codex transcript selection followed by Ctrl+C delivers exactly the synthetic selected text through tmux without a desktop clipboard environment, release-time copy, user data or model requests

Explicit cleanup requests SIGTERM only for current-user Mosh servers with verified packet age at or above 30 seconds; recheck freshness and PID identity, keep tmux programs, skip unavailable timestamps, and provide a signal-free preview

Explicit opt-in can close old Mosh servers marked UNREACHABLE using verified login PTY/process identity and a fresh flag recheck; no invented packet age, no arbitrary timeout guarantee, and no connected/new/unknown legacy cleanup
Display lowercase mosh/ssh or local terminal application with terminal PID in parentheses; retain structured transport compatibility and do not add process scans
Client-table column headers stay uppercase and every rendered value is lowercase without changing original identifiers or structured JSON
Fold app PID into APP and Mosh server PID into VIA, remove separate PID/link columns, preserve raw JSON fields and show coarse link only as an inline fallback when exact IDLE is unavailable
Report the foreground app current command on all inventory rows, with compact default and full verbose/JSON views, without changing identifier case in JSON or sampling additional process snapshots
Show direct Mosh/SSH and other-tmux PTY dimensions as columns x rows with read-only queries, refresh after resize, and retain existing individual tmux client geometry
Show current-user foreground VM terminal attachments as opsec-tmux in the host table, with actual host transport/app/geometry and no duplicate host tmux or remote rows
Resolve the actual guest session through one bounded query via an existing owned SSH master, never boot a VM/open TCP/create tmux servers, retain rows with a warning on failure or ambiguity
APP shows pi-opsec for verified VM Pi viewers and pi for a verified foreground Pi runtime/child instead of Bash, with accurate host PIDs and retained raw executable/argv metadata

Preserve the top visible logical history position through repeated terminal resizing while browsing copy mode, including selection/copy and temporary oversized viewports; scrolling selects a new position and live-bottom behavior remains native.
